terminal_install_prompt_body:
{iten_terminal} epwe iei suki {metoch}.

• Ika ese mwo fis, kopwe suki ewe {device}.
• Ika pwe a riri ngeni USB, kopwe akkomw angei.
{emwenin}
• Kopwe apachanong noumw we pisek ngeni noumw we komputer nupwen ewe {iten_terminal} a fen suk.

Klik OK pwe kopwe poputa me tou seni ewe Pworaus CE.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Tip: Ika ewe pisek ese pwisin fiti, kopwe ekis suki ewe reset button non ewe pinhole ren ew taropwe nupwen ka fiti ewe USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Tip: Kopwe isoni noumw we pisek non ewe napanap kopwe tongeni angei ewe pisekin angang (a sokono ren napanapan: e.g. kopwe angei ewe pisekin angang me kopwe tumunu pwe epwe tou ren ewe USB kabel, ika kopwe kouno ewe pochokun nupwen ka fiti ewe USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Kopwe äeä ewe GUI fän iten ewe pisekin angang SP .
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash ewe pisekin angang GUI epwe iei usun suk ren omw ewe pisekin angang a fen fis.

• Non ewe SP Flash Tool, kopwe finata "Format Meinisin + Angei" seni ewe nenien angang.
• Kopwe suki ewe "Angei" ewe kinikin.
• Kopwe tumunu pwe noumw we {device} epwe kouno me epwe kouno.
{emwenin}
• Kopwe apacha ngeni ewe USB ngeni noumw we komputer mwirin omw kopwe suki.

Kopwe OK pwe kopwe poputani ewe SP Flash me tou seni ewe Pworaus CE.

Ekkewe puken Rockbox-Y1 me mwen 0.5 rese tipeew ngeni ekkewe puken Y1 mi kamo mwirin March 2026 ren Innioasis OS 3.0.7 mi fen kawor me mwan.

Flash ew build mi nomw won ekkei pisek epwe eppeti booting.

Ka nukuw pwe ka mochen pwarata ekkewe Rockbox mi nomw me nomw?

Sia fen isoni {software} won om {model}.

Ei! Ngang Ryan, ewe chon fori ewe angangen fori ewe angangen forata ewe MediaTek. Ua moni monien hosting me tumunun pisek seni pocket pwe ei chon install epwe tongeni fis me epwe suk. Ika pwe a anisuk, kose mochen ekieki om kopwe awora — a amanaua ewe angang fan iten aramas meinisin.
donate_intro_general_mediatek: Eii! Ngang Ryan, ewe chon fori ewe angangen fori ewe angangen forata ewe MediaTek. donate_intro_success:
Sia fen isoni {software} won om {model}.

Ei! Ngang Ryan, ewe chon fori mwirin ewe Updater CE, ewe Pworaus mi Fich ngeni ewe Mwichen Aramas, me ewe Pworaus mi Pisekin Pwarata. Ua moni ach ~$200 maram server me monien tumun seni pocket pwe mettoch meinisin epwe tongeni fis me epwe suk. Ika ei pisekin angang a anisuk, kose mochen ekieki om kopwe awora — a tumunu ekkei pisekin aninis pwe repwe manau fan iten meinisin.
donate_intro_general: Eii! Ngang Ryan, ewe chon fori mwirin ewe Updater CE, ewe Pworaus mi Fich ngeni ewe Mwichen Aramas, me ewe Pworaus mi Pisekin Pwarata. themepack_card_title: Kopwe äeä ewe 360p Rockbox mi äeä ewe pworaus .
themepack_card_desc: A kapachelong ekkewe itelap mi ling, ekkewe minen urumot mi tekia, me ekkewe font mi for fan iten ekkewe minen pwarata mi 360p.
themepack_installed_success: ✓ Ewe Paken Temen 360p a fen fis!
themepack_step1_title: Tetten 1: Kopwe fiti ewe Mochen USB .
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Kopwe suki noumw we nenien urumot ren omw kopwe amwochu ewe Power.
2. Nupwen Rockbox a poputa, kopwe suki ewe USB ngeni noumw we komputer.
3. Ika pwe a tingor won ewe nenien urumot, kopwe affata ewe napanapen tumunun USB pwe ewe pisek epwe pwa usun ew drive.
themepack_step2_title: Tetten 2: Fili Ewe Folder won ewe Pwarata .
themepack_step2_desc: Pokiten ekkewe minen angang (usun macOS) ra kan opalo ekkewe pisekin angang (usun .rockbox) ren pwungun, ka tongeni filata EKKEWE chon angang are ewe minen angang won noum we chon angang. Sipwe pwisin kutta ika fori ewe .rockbox fan itom.
themepack_btn_select_folder: Fili ewe Pworaus won ewe Pworaus...
themepack_complete: Ewe pack mi fis! Iei ka tongeni túmúnúéchú óm kopwe chék chéúfetál me filatá eú itelap lón Rockbox (Ekkewe kókkót > Ekkewe kókkótun itelap).
themepack_err_not_found: Ese tongeni kuna ika poputani ew .rockbox won ewe nenien angang mi kefinita. Kopwe tumunu pwe ka finata ew folder won noumw we player.
rockbox_wizard_title: Ekkewe itelap me ekkewe font mi fis lon Rockbox 360p
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Tetten 1: Kopwe poputásefál le fiti me fitisefáli .
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Kopwe suki ewe USB.
2. Kopwe pochokun ngeni ewe chon fiti me mut ngeni epwe boot non Rockbox.
3. Nupwen Rockbox a fen fiti, kopwe suki sefani ewe USB, iwe kopwe suki Sopweno.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Step 2: Kutta ewe chon fiti ewe ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Ewe app a nenengeni ew ADB (tori 30 seken). Ika a wor eú pisek, ekkewe itelap ra siwil me ewe chón fiti a pwisin poputásefál. Ika esap ina, kopwe fiti ewe Mochen USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: A witiwiti ew pisekin ADB... (tori 30 seken)
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: Ewe pisekin angang a nom ({seri}); siwini ekkewe itelap...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Ese wor ew pisekin ADB a fis non 30 seken; sopweno ren ewe Mochen USB.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Ese wor ADB mi kawor ngeni ewe app; sopweno ren ewe Mochen USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Pusin ekkewe itelap me ekkewe font won ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: ADB a siwin a fis; fall sefan ngeni ewe Napanapen USB .
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Kopwe äeä ewe USB le äeä ewe Mode .
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Kopwe fori ewe Mode ren USB won ewe nenien urumot pwe epwe pwa usun ew drive.
2. Kopwe finata EKKEWE CHON ANGANG won ewe nenien urumot fan (.rockbox, Nikáttik, Tettenin, ika ewe root — ew nenien .rockbox mi monomon a nomw non ewe nenien urumot).
3. Ewe app a ionfengenni ekkewe 360p itelap me ekkewe font non, a makkei ekkewe file mi chok nomw non.
rockbox_wizard_done_title: 360p ekkewe itelap & ekkewe fon ra nom!
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Iei ka tongeni túmúnú pwe kopwe chék chéúfetál me filatá eú itelap lón Rockbox (Ekkewe kókkót > Ekkewe kókkótun itelap).
legacy_cleanup_title: Kopwe angei ewe app mi nom .
legacy_cleanup_desc: Ew kinikinin Updater mi pin a chuen nom won ei komputer me a angei nenien disk. Ach sipwe äeä ena a angasalo ena leeni.
legacy_cleanup_reclaim: A angei sefani arapakan {ukukun} ewe nenien disk
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Kopwe angei ekkewe pisekin angangen Innioasis mi nomw me ekkewe pisekin aninis .
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Kopwe äeä ekkewe pisekin angang lon Android (ADB) .
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Ika kese aea ADB ika Fastboot lukun ewe Updater CE, kopwe suki ewe chek pwe kopwe angei me angei sefani ekkewe pisekin tumun.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: A sopwoch le alimelima ewe legacy me angei sefani ewe leenien disk.
legacy_cleanup_card_title: Kopwe angei ewe app mi nom .
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Ew kinikinin Updater mi nomw non ei computer. Ika ka äeä ena, epwe äeä ewe leenien disk.
legacy_cleanup_none_found: Ese wor eu minen lom lom a kuna.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Ei a angeiano ewe app me an kewe pisekin aninis. Ekkewe föün äsefich ra äeä.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Kopwe pwal äeä ewe minen älillis fän iten Android (ADB)? Kopwe finata Keep ika pwe ka aea ADB.
